thread:
maria: RFC follow-up: propose a small-surface 'policy-plane' cutover to shrink inference-config contract and isolate policy evaluation. objective: reduce hotpath branching in runtime.
aj: Agree in principle. What's the minimal change set to get started?
maria: Minimal: 1) read-only policy-plane API for runtime lookups, 2) snapshot+delta backfill from legacy DB, 3) router header to pick route, 4) compatibility sidecar for old adapters.
simon: Snapshot+delta -> how do we keep sync tight?
maria: Plan: take snapshot at T0, backfill into policy_plane.policies, then run a tiny CDC consumer to apply deltas. We keep a small TTL on runtime cache to force revalidation during canary. SQL for snapshot: 
```sql
INSERT INTO policy_plane.policies (id, cfg, updated_at)
SELECT id, cfg, updated_at FROM legacy.inference_policies WHERE updated_at <= :T0;
```
CDC consumer is just a lightweight Kafka consumer that writes to policy_plane.
katie: Router changes? need to avoid tenant-wide blast radius.
simon: We'll use shard-based ramping: router adds header `x-policy-plane=beta` for selected shard ids. Envoy filter reads header and routes to policy-plane.
infra-bot: Deploy note: create new envoy filter `policy-plane-router` and canary with 5% shards first. Use k8s rollout: `kubectl -n inference set image deployment/router router=router:policy-plane-canary`
aj: Compatibility sidecar details?
maria: Sidecar runs alongside legacy adapter, exposes same local API but proxies to policy-plane. It also implements field-mapping for policy_v1 -> policy_v2. This lets us cut traffic without touching all adapters.
katie: What about writes? who is authoritative?
maria: New policy service becomes authoritative. We'll block direct writes to legacy table during cutover window and surface a write-limiter rule for 48h. Any writes go through policy service which writes both new store and emits CDC for legacy sync in reverse if needed.
simon: Rollback criteria?
maria: Rollback if router.policy_plane_5xx > 0.3% sustained for 5m, or if p95 latency delta > 40ms for 10m. Also if adapter.fallback_rate > 1% for 10m.
aj: Monitoring/alerts to create?
maria: Create dashboards and alerts: `metric:policy_plane_lookup_rate`, `metric:policy_plane_5xx`, `metric:policy_sync_lag_ms`, `metric:adapter_fallbacks`. Also add a synthetic check hitting a canary tenant path every 30s.
katie: Cost/ops tradeoffs? CDC consumers + sidecars add infra cost. We'll estimate ~2-3% extra until cutover. Add to the monthly ops forecast.
simon: Timeline/owners?
maria: Owners: maria (architecture), aj (runtime), simon (router), infra (deploy). Timeline: spike this sprint, infra canary next week, shard ramp over 3 weeks, full cut month-end.
aj: Tests before canary: unit + contract lints, integration test hitting sidecar, load test at expected QPS for policy lookups, and a chaos test that kills sidecar.
maria: Add debt ticket INF-4601: "policy-plane: legacy adapter audit & prune" so we don't leave sidecars forever.
infra-bot: Reminder: schedule DB snapshot during low traffic. Avoid long locks; use read replica for snapshot if possible.
katie: OK let's sync tomorrow 9am for dry-run. I'll prepare the alert rules and runbook.
maria: Thanks, will update RFC with scripts and rollout playbook. :rocket:
